whenToUse: Lightly agreeing with a post or comment.
The number of people who pressed it matters.
It turns on and off in one press.
whenNotToUse: Saving just for yourself (use a wishlist or bookmark).
Several feelings must be told apart (use emoji reactions).
A rating score is needed (use a star rating).

alternatives.name: Wishlist / Bookmark
alternatives.reason: Saving to your own list to see later.

accessibility: Announce the pressed state with aria-pressed.
The button name includes Like and the count.
The pop effect is skipped with reduced motion.
